item.title: Trump signs bill to end partial government shutdown, setting stage for next fight
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — President Donald Trump signed a roughly $1.2 trillion government funding bill Tuesday that ends the partial federal shutdown that began over the weekend and sets the stage for an intense debate in Congress over Homeland Security funding. item.title: Haitian, Burmese immigrants in MI keep legal protections, for now
item.description: Recent court orders are giving members of Southwest Michigan's Burmese and Haitian immigrant communities some relief as federal officials look to end temporary protected status for people from those countries and others.

item.title: GRPD Chief Eric Winstrom taking chief job in Florida
item.description: Police Chief Eric Winstrom is leaving Grand Rapids after four years to take over the police department in Pensacola, Florida.

item.title: Lowell High School students walk out of class in protest of ICE
item.description: Students at Lowell High School walked out of class Tuesday afternoon to protest actions against Immigration Customs Enforcement and the Trump Administration's conduct in the aftermath of the killing of two citizens in Minneapolis.
